description.value: Listel Whistler is a full-service hotel tucked into a quiet cul-de-sac off the main pedestrian stroll of Whistler Village, just a short walk from the base lifts to both Whistler and Blackcomb mountains. The hotel features a Cedar Gallery Floor showcasing Indigenous Canadian art and the legendary Bearfoot Bistro restaurant with its underground wine cellar and Grey Goose Ice Room. Touring cyclists will find secure bike storage, guest laundry, and immediate access to Whistler's world-class trail network right outside the door.
